prompt: A breathtaking view overlooking a grand Disney-style castle under a stunning moonlit sky. A crystal-clear river flows around the castle, reflecting the moonlight in a dreamlike scene. In front of the castle, a charming steampunk town features a railway with a steam locomotive crossing a bridge over the river. The town includes an old-fashioned bank, vintage shops, horse-drawn carriages, and early 20th-century automobiles, all bathed in warm, glowing lights. At the town square, people celebrate a vibrant festival under bright lanterns, playing guitars, cellos, violins, and a grand piano. The scene exudes a magical, warm autumn night atmosphere. Extreme texture fidelity, photo-realistic lighting and reflections. --ar 1:2 --v 6.1
